description: Pinpoint grammars (para/section/page with value sequences) extracted verbatim from the two lineages: the splitter dialect (ALR deterministic_splitter.py == engine deterministic_citations.py) and the toa_maker dialect. The defs mirror the source rf-string composition (_PIN_ITEM/_PIN_SEPARATOR/_PIN_SEQUENCE vs _PINPOINT_VALUE/_PINPOINT_LIST) so each fragment keeps one edit point. Dialects differ on: ranges inside an item (splitter) vs dash-as-list-separator (toa), 'to' as a separator (toa only), '&' as a separator (splitter only), pre-parenthesis space (splitter only), paragraph ¶ (splitter only), 'subsection' keyword (splitter only), and page-abbreviation period placement.

entries.provenance: splitter.py:87-89 (_PAR_PIN_RE). ¶ accepted; named group 'values' is in the source ((?P<values>) translated to JS syntax).

splitter.py:90-94 (_SEC_PIN_RE). Keyword set includes 'subsection'; named group in source.
